components.author: sdsremote
components.name: sdsremote-sbom-generator
components.description: Enriches syft's Dart inventory with lock hashes, exact-version licences, scopes and SDK components.

properties.name: sdsremote:sbom:scope
properties.value: runtime dependencies of the release; dev/test-only packages are included with scope=excluded

properties.name: sdsremote:license:method
properties.value: SPDX ids detected from the primary LICENSE/COPYING files of the exact locked versions in the pub cache (third-party notice files such as LICENSE-other.md excluded); pub.dev score tags only as fallback (they describe the latest version)

properties.name: sdsremote:license:status
properties.value: unknown: no LICENSE file in patched package
